'''Mandragoran''' is the surname of the Royal House of the [[Malkier]]i and could refer to the following people:

*[[al'Lan Mandragoran]] - the uncrowned king of the Malkieri and husband to Nynaeve.
*[[Nynaeve al'Meara|el'Nynaeve ti al'Meara Mandragoran]] - [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Yellow Ajah]] and wife of Lan.
*[[al'Akir Mandragoran]] - father of Lan and the last crowned king of the Malkieri, now deceased.
*[[el'Leanna Mandragoran]] - mother of Lan and the last crowned queen of the Malkieri, now deceased.
*[[Lain Mandragoran]] - brother of al'Akir and uncle of Lan, killed in the [[Great Blight]].
*[[Breyan Mandragoran]] - wife of Lain and aunt of Lan, her ultimate fate is unknown.
*[[Slayer#Isam|Isam Mandragoran]] - son of Lain and Breyan and cousin of Lan, attacked by [[Trolloc]]s in the Great Blight.
